name: After recital 3
title: REPORT on the proposal for a decision of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Decision (EU) 2015/1814 as regards the market stability reserve for the buildings, road transport and additional sectors
part_text: (3a) The emissions trading scheme for the buildings, road transport and additional sectors may place a significant additional burden on households, businesses and consumers. When designing the market stability reserve, particular consideration should therefore be given to the impact on heating and transport costs, low- and middle-income households, rural regions, small and medium-sized enterprises, and the risk of exacerbating energy and transport poverty. The Social Climate Fund is not designed to fully and permanently offset all the additional burdens arising from the emissions trading scheme.
